title: Riley random catchups + errands (weekend sprint)
content:
Notes to self: weekend sprint + random catchups

Top-of-head plan (today / tomorrow)
- Morning: triage inbox, quick PRs (aim to clear <= 2h)
- Midday: pair with Nadia on SDK net-new config option (30-60m)
- Afternoon: run local perf repro for latency spike on canary, write up short blameless note
- Evening: errands + recharge (groceries, drop off package)

Quick TODOs (priority ordering)
1) High - investigate canary latency spike
   - repro steps: curl against local canary with same request size (seq len ~1024)
   - command to run: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer __' -d '@test/payloads/long_seq.json' > out.json
   - collect: p50/p95 p99, kernel logs, GPU utilization snapshot (nvidia-smi --query), KV cache hit ratio from runtime logs
   - estimate 2.5h, include notes for SRE handoff if >30% error increase

2) Medium - SDK config PR follow-up (#987)
   - review comments from Omar, add one unit test for env var fallback
   - checklist: run unit tests locally, update changelog line, mark ready for squash

3) Low - personal admin
   - apply for parking permit (renewal): https://city-portal.example/permits
   - pay utility bill (auto-pay failed?) -> check bank app, set reminder on Mon

Errands + personal checklist (today)
- [x] Buy milk + coffee pods
- [x] Drop off return at UPS (label printed)
- [ ] Fix bike tire at shop (estimate 45m) - call CycleWorks to confirm they can pick up
- [ ] Call Dr. Patel (annual follow-up) - leave voicemail if office closed
- [ ] Pack chargers for SFO trip (Tue)

Meeting notes / quick links to transcribe later
- 10:00 sync with Product (Nadia): discuss rollout cadence for new batcher heuristics
  - product asked for canary window of 48h, we pushed back to 24h for faster feedback
  - action: produce short doc with metrics to watch (latency, cost/unit, error rate) by Mon EOD

- 14:30 ad-hoc with SRE: spike looks correlated with KV cache misses when seq > 512
  - next: instrument per-request KV-miss tag, add sample tracing for 5% of requests

Random capture / brain dump (don't lose these)
- Idea: small CLI tool that queries Redwood Console for per-route token-cost summary and outputs CSV for finance. Could be 1-day hack. Name: console-exporter
- Ticket to create: GH issue under tools/console-exporter, include quick auth flow and sample output columns

Personal micro-retro (this week)
- Wins: closed two long-standing flaky SDK tests, latency improved after kernel patch on dev nodes
- Frustrations: meetings often drift without clear decisions -> try shorter agendas + timeboxes next week
- Experiment: 2h focus blocks in AM worked well, keep doing it

Unresolved questions (follow up list)
- Who owns the quantization profile docs for the 3-axis models? (ask Research/Applied ML)
- Can we safely widen canary to include one dedicated GPU pool for 24h? (need cost estimate)

Tiny reminders to self (one-liners)
- backup: export notes to Obsidian weekly on Sunday
- stretch: 10 min between standups
- buy: new travel adapter (3 USB-C)

Grocery quick list (for tonight)
- eggs, oat milk, spinach, coffee pods, avocados, small loaf of sourdough

End-of-day wrap (what to push to Mon)
- write the canary incident notes doc (short, timeline, action items)
- create GH issue for console-exporter prototype
- ping Finance about usage spikes in March billing (attach p95 graphs)

Mood: tired but productive. Keep it small and finish one thing properly.

-----
Contextual notes for later tidy-up:
- Move perf logs to /tmp/redwood-debug/YYYYMMDD-<tag> and attach to GH issue when done
- If latency repro fails locally, escalate to SRE with collected traces and nsys capture

End of scratchpad.
